components.purpose: Opening section: the event title (Heading) and a register button (CTA 1 link) over a gradient background (backgroundType set to a gradient such as yellow-pink). It is built for the top of a page and fits the 'title and register button over a gradient' request.
Short free-text agenda between the hero and the form. It is the built-in free-form component for text, so it covers the agenda without a structured list.

Registration form at the bottom. It is the only visible form component with a heading, description, submit URL and success/error messages. It is a contact form rather than a dedicated registration form, so the registration fields will need to be set up through its submit URL, and the marketer should confirm it fits.
